title: Heading of the access log's card: each time an admin opened a person's activity, a chat or a turn's trace.
description: Under the heading. {{minutes}} is how long a repeated open of the same list is counted once. "Turn": one answer from a socio (an AI agent). "Trace": a turn's record of what the model and tools did.
empty: Shown in place of the log when it has no entries.
content: Badge on an entry whose view showed content (a chat's messages), not only who and when.
request: Tooltip on an entry's time: {{id}} is the server request's id; keep it as is.
subject.workspace: An entry's subject when the admin opened the whole workspace's turns rather than one person's or chat's.
subject.removed-room: An entry's subject: a Room (a shared chat of people and socios; a product noun) that was removed since.
subject.deleted-chat: An entry's subject: a chat that was deleted since.
subject.room: Badge beside a subject that is a Room (a shared chat of people and socios; a product noun).
context.from: After an entry: the dashboard page it was opened from. {{section}} is a page's name (Overview, Activity…). Lowercase "from", as it continues the line.
context.filter: After an entry, how the view was narrowed; several are joined with commas. {{value}} is a name (a socio's, a person's, a Space's, a Room's) or an id. Each context: socio (an AI agent; product noun), person, space (a Space; product noun), source (a channel such as web or Telegram), room (a Room; product noun), initiator (the person whose message started a Room's turn). Lowercase, as it continues the line.
context.other: The same for any other setting the view had: {{name}} is its stored name (such as range), {{value}} its value (such as 30d); keep both as they are.
surfaces.turns: Each surfaces.*: the kind of view an admin opened, in the access log. "Turn": one answer from a socio.
surfaces.trace: A turn's trace: its record of what the model and tools did.
surfaces.activity: The Activity page narrowed to one person.
surfaces.value: The Value page narrowed to one person.
surfaces.failure-label: A failed turn's label (why it failed) and the text its classifier read.
surfaces.health: The Health page's tokens used, by person.
surfaces.health-long-runs: Health's list of turns that ran long.
surfaces.chat-grounding: What a chat's turns read (pages, datasets) to answer.
surfaces.session-labels: Themes' list of sessions whose labels (intent, topics) an admin reviews.
surfaces.room-events: A Room's own audit: who joined, left or was refused. "Room" is a product noun.
